結 Est. 2016 · Kumamoto, Japan

Homes built around the way you actually live.

YBEES Inc. designs and builds custom residences with an emphasis on craft, quiet materials, and layouts that make everyday life easier. From first sketch to final key-handoff, one team sees every project through.

About YBEES

A small team that stays close to every build, from design to the final walkthrough.

YBEES Inc. was founded on a simple idea: a house should be designed around the people who live in it, not the other way around. We work directly with each client through design, materials selection, and construction, keeping the same small team on the project from the first meeting to the final handoff.

Services

What we handle for you, start to finish.

Custom Home Design

Floor plans and elevations built around your site, your budget, and how your household actually moves through a day.

Interior & Renovation

Kitchens, LDK layouts, and full interior fit-outs — from material samples through the final coat of paint.

Construction Management

One point of contact managing the schedule, the crews, and the budget, with regular walkthroughs as the build progresses.
